en.topic_title: Yuen Long district councillor convicted of having intercourse with girl under 16
en.topic_summary:
A Yuen Long district councillor has been found guilty of having intercourse with a girl under 16 over a decade ago, prompting a government investigation that could see him suspended from duties.



Yuen Long district councillor Sei Chun-hing. Photo: Sei Chun-hing, via Facebook.
